name: Count the fires
text: Count not the miles beneath your feet. Count the fires that welcomed you.

inspired_by.note: Original composition after Bronze Age hospitality verses. Not a translation, and not a quotation.

sources: the owner's draft of nomadic-migration sayings for the cutscenes, 2026-10-01
notes: Carried by the harappan since 2 October 2026: the owner asked for the fictional sayings to belong to the lore's various peoples, not all to the Vedda.
